import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { OPEN_GAP_STATUSES } from "@/lib/wallet/gap-status"

export async function liveForPolicy(policyId: string, gapId: string) {
    const rows = await db.gapInstance.findMany({
        where: { policyId, status: { in: [...OPEN_GAP_STATUSES] }, supersededAt: null },
    })
    const current = await db.gapInstance.count({
        where: { policyId, status: { in: ["open", "detected", "acknowledged"] }, supersededAt: null },
    })
    const one = await db.gapInstance.findFirst({ where: { id: gapId, policyId } })
    // A nested include whose live filter sits well below the relation line: the
    // window is brace-matched, not 14 lines.
    const policy = await db.policy.findUnique({
        where: { id: policyId },
        include: {
            gapInstances: {
                include: {
                    definition: {
                        select: {
                            slug: true,
                            title: true,
                            description: true,
                            severity: true,
                            category: true,
                            lineOfBusiness: true,
                            ruleId: true,
                            provenance: true,
                            citation: true,
                            createdAt: true,
                            updatedAt: true,
                            active: true,
                        },
                    },
                    analysisRun: { select: { id: true, finishedAt: true } },
                },
                where: { status: { in: [...OPEN_GAP_STATUSES] }, supersededAt: null },
            },
        },
    })
    return { rows, current, one, policy }
}
